name: Aikawa Souma
source: Aikawa is friend of protag when he first moved. Aikawa went through a delinquent phase hanging out with bad crowd and fighting. But recently because of protag has made changes to better him self even if he still has some bad habits. Most of teachers and student still see him as a delinquent so is still disliked by majority. But still gets along with protag as friends.
